tabs.name: Match 1 Results
rows: To make input of results quicker copy & paste (paste values is best as it matches the destination formatting) the cells from the excel declarations sheets into the correct columns
Scroll down to around cell R595 and be careful to paste values the correct team into the correct column, this will transfer
the athletes names into column N to the left of this description, they will not show in competition result order
but they are in view so you can use the equals sign " = " and click on the club athlete name
doing it this way is a beifit because when the Team Manager chnges athlete after the event you can change that at the foot of the spreadsheet
You need to input the performance and the club name, once you have input the club name once it will auto complete
in further cells (assuming that the dots "." have not been accidently broken.
